cases.what_failed: nothing failed; the gate consumed a dataclass instead of its .caught field
cases.what_was_returned: status="FLAG" on every read, because a ConscienceReading is always truthy
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: inverse case: OK was unreachable, so the mount's calibration was decorative
cases.consumer: the policy on_flag hook fires on every honest generation
cases.fix: gate on reading.caught

cases.what_failed: the calibrated gate fired, and a looser disjunct overrode it
cases.what_was_returned: passed=True for a draft the trusted gate had flagged
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the draft ships as if it had cleared review
cases.fix: passed = not needs_revision; ceiling_only is a logged diagnostic

cases.what_failed: styxx.weather(window=N) raised TypeError on EVERY call - the kwarg does not exist
cases.what_was_returned: {"gate": "pass"} with no error field
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: "pass" is the healthy value of the gate vocabulary
cases.consumer: an MCP agent reading fleet health
cases.fix: error/no_data/pass are three distinguishable payloads; call uses the real signature

cases.what_failed: an invalid API key, rate limit or timeout raised inside the vendor call
cases.what_was_returned: GateVerdict(trust_score=1.0, will_refuse=0.0, will_confabulate=0.0)
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: 1.0 is the maximum of the trust range
cases.consumer: docs route callers to threshold on verdict.trust_score
cases.fix: fall back to the text heuristic; neutral 0.5 if that also fails

cases.what_failed: the cogn_composite field was absent from the log entry
cases.what_was_returned: composite=0.0, a valid-looking measurement
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: a constant series feeds the correlation as real data
cases.fix: an absent field is malformed input, surfaced with its line number

cases.what_failed: one series had zero variance, so Pearson r is undefined
cases.what_was_returned: 0.0, returned as an ordinary correlation coefficient
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: 0.0 asserts 'no relationship', a definite null result
cases.consumer: the locked scorer for a preregistered coherence claim
cases.fix: refuse; series with real variance are numerically unchanged

cases.what_failed: the fit targets had zero variance, so R-squared is undefined
cases.what_was_returned: r2 = 1.0 regardless of the residuals
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: 1.0 is perfect explained variance - the metric the docstring says to check
cases.consumer: callers testing r2 > threshold for model health
cases.fix: NaN, which fails the health test rather than passing it

cases.what_failed: the trajectories were empty or absent
cases.what_was_returned: predicted_category=reasoning, confidence=0.695, risk_level=low
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: a confident low-risk forecast manufactured from the origin of feature space
cases.consumer: ForecastGate compares risk_level against a threshold
cases.fix: measured=False, category unknown, and the gate returns None

cases.what_failed: no entry in the window carried a confidence reading
cases.what_was_returned: mean_confidence = 0.5, above the 0.30 floor
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the min_confidence violation can never fire
cases.fix: confidence_measured=False and the leg is skipped explicitly

cases.what_failed: nothing; the verifier re-derived only one field of the verdict
cases.what_was_returned: VERIFIED for a receipt whose passed_register_audit had been flipped
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the shipped example prints that field beside the VERIFIED stamp
cases.fix: re-derive the whole verdict, including issue_receipt's own invariant

cases.what_failed: the trajectory never reached a verdict (gate 'pending') or scoring crashed ('error')
cases.what_was_returned: valid=True, because the test was gate != 'fail'
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: an incomplete measurement is indistinguishable from a passing one
cases.fix: valid requires a completed gate; measured is exposed

cases.what_failed: the trajectory was empty
cases.what_was_returned: confabulation_ratio=0.0 with a 'steady' aggregate state
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: a perfectly calm truth map of nothing at all
cases.consumer: anyone rendering or thresholding a TruthMap
cases.fix: measured=False and render() says NO TRAJECTORY

cases.what_failed: nothing; the verifier never recomputed the cross-language chain it writes
cases.what_was_returned: ok=True regardless of what the portable digests held
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the leg whose purpose is third-party verification was the one leg unverified
cases.fix: walk the portable leg in lockstep, recomputed from each attestation

cases.what_failed: the envelope carried no timestamp
cases.what_was_returned: time.time(), so validate()'s 'required positive number' could never fire
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: an undated or forged envelope reads as freshly created
cases.fix: absence survives deserialization as 0.0 and the validator rejects it

cases.what_failed: a NaN scale survived the degenerate-dimension guard, because NaN < 1e-9 is False
cases.what_was_returned: every z-score NaN, so every threshold comparison False
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: risk_level lands on 'low' by fallthrough
cases.fix: non-finite scales are degenerate too

cases.what_failed: both resampling arms collected nothing
cases.what_was_returned: divergence 0.0, suspected=False
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: an injection detector that never ran reported no injection
cases.consumer: context-injection defence at the caller layer
cases.fix: either arm unsampled means measured=False, NaN divergence, fail closed

cases.what_failed: nothing; ground truth was derived from the system's own gate
cases.what_was_returned: outcome='correct' whenever gate=='pass'
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: the label agrees with the classifier by construction
cases.fix: outcome_source provenance, and every consumer refuses auto labels

cases.what_failed: nothing; the calibrator selected labels the classifier had written
cases.what_was_returned: centroid shifts trained on the model's own verdicts
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: agreement rises, and the drift arrives looking like evidence
cases.fix: refuse auto-stamped labels; report n_auto_excluded

cases.what_failed: nothing measured the entry at all - it is an operator's self-report
cases.what_was_returned: gate='pass'
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: self-report is in LIVE_SOURCES, so it inflates every pass rate
cases.fix: gate is None; the declared-risk warn branch stays

cases.what_was_returned: entropy 0.0 for four different Japanese answers (1.386 in latin)
cases.why_it_reads_healthy: 0.0 is the most confident reading: one cluster, the model knows
